string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Runs the Sub-Store backend and web UI on this device to convert and manage Surge, Loon, QX, Stash, Clash and sing-box subscriptions

string.name: perm_internet
string.value: Runs the local Sub-Store service and fetches the remote subscriptions, scripts and sync services you add

string.name: perm_netinfo
string.value: Reads this device's LAN IP address to build LAN subscription links

string.name: perm_bg
string.value: Keeps serving subscriptions in the background after you turn on background running

string.name: perm_biometric
string.value: Used to unlock the app with your fingerprint (optional, needs an access password)
